sentences.text: The process of de-sealing will commence on 13.12.2023 at 2:30 PM and continue till the process ends.
Inspector Bhupinder Kumar, who is present in Court, shall afford all Police assistance for the purpose of de- sealing and removal of the goods.
The FSSAI shall also depute such technical officers which would be required for de-sealing of the premises.
6. It is stated by learned Counsel for the Respondent/FSSAI that there are two trucks outside the factory also containing certain meat articles.
The Court Commissioner is requested to take Inventory of those articles also.
Let the Report be filed in this Court before the next date of hearing.
7. Upon the removal of the goods, let the factory be re-sealed pending the writ petition.

8. Needless to state that this order is without prejudice to the rights and contentions of all parties and contentions of all parties are left open.
9. A sum of Rs.1,50,000/- is fixed as remuneration for the Court Commissioner, to be shared by the Petitioner and the Respondent in equal halves which could be finally adjusted.
